name: app
title: App (sign-in + dashboard)
description: Supabase sign-in (email + password, magic link, optional Google), a protected dashboard and a profile page. Demo mode until you connect your own Supabase project.

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
env.comment:
Your own Supabase project's URL (Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API).
Leave empty for demo mode: sign-in is switched off and /dashboard shows sample data.

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
env.comment:
Your own project's publishable key (sb_publishable_...). Safe in the browser: Row Level Security protects the data.
Never put the secret / service-role key here or in any NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable.

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_GOOGLE_ENABLED
env.comment: Set to true only after enabling the Google provider in Supabase (Authentication > Sign In / Providers).

next: Runs in demo mode until you connect your own Supabase project: run /setup in Claude Code or follow kits/app/README.md (create the project, add the two keys to .env.local, run supabase/migrations/*_profiles.sql). Then build your feature in app/dashboard/page.tsx.
